entities.summary: The National University of Singapore (NUS) is a national public research university in Singapore. It was officially established in 1980 through the government-directed merger of the public University of Singapore and the private Nanyang University. National University of Singapore is a nonprofit organization in Asia, established in 1905. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 58 language editions of Wikipedia.
